description:
Cloudya Desktop App

Cloudya is NFON's smart business communication platform that helps make your workflow smart. It has several functions, including cloud telephony.
New features:
- Implemented support for the tel: URI protocol, allowing users to initiate calls directly from external applications.

Improvements:
- The app has been updated to the latest stable version of Electron, improving compatibility and performance on both Mac and Windows platforms.
- The cause of unusually high login activity for certain users has been addressed, resulting in more consistent and balanced login behaviour.

Bug fixes:
- Incoming calls remain visible and fully manageable after unlocking the PC, with all notification functions operating as expected.
- Audio settings have been optimised to ensure full audio availability on the first call after launching the app.
